messages:
samira: Heads-up 10x: AtlasCore (enterprise) wants to POC atlas-core-52b:q3 on Dedicated. asks: is variant in catalog, KV-cache behavior, EKM/KMS support, and a rough POC price. can someone triage?

leo_ops: who's the contact and what's the expected workload?

samira: contact is nate@atlascore.ai. workload = multi-turn agent + embedding-indexing; lots of long contexts (6k-12k) with heavy KV reuse.

priya: q3 quant generally good for cost. i'll run a quick variant-compat scan against a100-80 Dedicated and check kv-cache memory and kernel paths. kicking off now.

presales-bot: scan started: job=atlas_q3_9901. checks: kv-cache, kernel-compat, tokenization. ETA ~4m.

priya: quick note: if we keep KV cache in fp16 we may see +12% memory usage vs fp16 model baseline due to alignment padding; compute should be ~-16%.

presales-bot: scan complete. job=atlas_q3_9901. summary: kernel compatible after minor shim, KV-cache overhead +11.7%, tokenization parity ok except one edge case (0.12% prompts). report: https://s3.redwood.ai/presales/atlas_q3_9901/report.html

leo_ops: no blockers. two action items: 1) prepare ops runbook for EKM flow (they requested external HSM), 2) schedule Dedicated pool with updated kernel to avoid shim. validation ~1-2 business days.

sec-bot: security note added: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS; external KMS/HSM (EKM) requires ops integration and an acceptance test plan. draft QA line: "EKM supported with ops coordination and short validation window."

billing-bot: pricing ballpark: q3 runtime ~-15% compute vs fp16, infra delta from KV +12%, plus one-time EKM integration fee. i'll draft a POC quote and send by EOD tomorrow.

samira: thanks. can someone paste a minimal repro for the tokenization edge case so we can share with AtlasCore?

priya: here is the failing prompt (small repro):

```
Prompt: "Condense: \"We'll deploy at 09:00\" 1 with nested quotes and emoji \uD83D\uDE0A"
```

priya: reproduces a 1-token shift in ~0.12% of cases on q3 build. patch ready if they want parity, otherwise safe for POC.

samira: great. assigned: priya = token-fix + ops report, leo = kernel scheduling + validation, billing-bot = quote, sec-bot = finalize EKM text. i'll email nate with the report link and tentative timelines. closing for now unless they ask for deeper perf numbers.
